name: warp-background

frames.best_why: The most beams are in flight here, framing the grid tunnel with purple, green, orange and blue streaks.

tagline: Coloured beams shoot through a receding grid tunnel.
summary: A card background drawn as a 3D perspective grid tunnel, with coloured light beams racing from the edges toward the centre on looping timers.
appearance: A dark tunnel of nested rectangular grid outlines receding to a vanishing point, crossed by angled coloured light streaks in green, purple, blue and orange. A small panel of text sits in the middle.
behaviour: Beams shoot from the outer edges toward the centre on repeating loops, each with its own random hue, delay and speed, while the grid tunnel itself stays still.
demo_content: The centre panel reads "Warp Background" above the heading "Perspective Grid".
use_when: A card or panel should feel like it is travelling forward, such as a launch or sci-fi theme.
avoid_when: Content-led pages: the busy tunnel and bright beams compete with text.
customise: Perspective depth, beams per side, beam width, delay range, duration and grid colour are props; beam hues are random in the source.
weight_why: A dozen motion-driven beams plus a CSS 3D grid; continuous but few nodes.

a11y.note: The animated backdrop is decorative with no focusable parts; the endless motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Convincing 3D tunnel and energetic beams; the random hues occasionally clash.
